report_name: Phase 3 repository-backed originality audit and human-review queue
scope: Every public page in the Phase 2 repository inventory; all ten master-command questions are represented per page.
method: Deterministic repository-only triage using page metadata, visible main-body structure, text samples and the current Phase 2 signals. No AI detector, live crawl, external plagiarism comparison, native-speaker review, authorship validation or source fact-check is performed.

priority_policy.P1_REVIEW: Indexable and Phase 2 HIGH; first editorial review queue, not a defect finding.
priority_policy.P2_REVIEW: Indexable and Phase 2 MEDIUM; review before future optimization or republication decisions.
priority_policy.P3_CONFIRM: Indexable and Phase 2 LOW; confirm page intent/value, not automatic approval.
priority_policy.HELD_NOINDEX_CONTENT: Non-indexable content-type page with at least 100 repository words; keep current noindex until separately reviewed.
priority_policy.NOINDEX_UTILITY_OR_PLACEHOLDER: Noindex utility, research or short placeholder; preserve current state.
priority_policy.shared_paragraph_policy: Shared paragraphs are evidence pointers only and do not independently raise priority or imply a defect.

human_review_contract.page_level_status: Every page remains NOT_PERFORMED until a named editor records an actual review.
not_claimed: originality or uniqueness versus the public web

limitations: A title/H1-derived user-intent candidate is not proof the page answers that need.
Tables, lists, scripts, forms and tools are structural signals; they do not prove examples are original or useful.
Keyword stuffing, synonym spinning, machine-translation quality, fake claims, unsupported statistics, contradictions and copied external text require contextual human review.
Shared paragraph signatures intentionally normalize numbers. Different numeric examples can share a signature, and a shared paragraph alone is not a defect.
No page content, recommendation, canonical, robots state or publication setting is changed by this report.

visible_text_sample.opening_paragraph: Greet through the day, introduce yourself with よろしく, and bow at the right depth — with particles は and も.
visible_text_sample.closing_paragraph: ありがとうございます (arigatō gozaimasu) is full thanks; どうも is its casual shadow. "You're welcome" is どういたしまして. visible_text_sample.opening_paragraph: Read romanised Chinese, nail the four tones plus neutral tone, and learn why mā and mà are different words.
visible_text_sample.closing_paragraph: Tones shift in company. The big two: third-tone sandhi — two third tones in a row turn the FIRST into a second: 你好 is written nǐ hǎo but said ní hǎo. And 不 (bù) turns second tone before a fourth: 不对 is bú duì, not bù duì. Don't panic — internalise the written tones first; sandhi becomes automatic with listening.

visible_text_sample.opening_paragraph: Chinese has no single "to be": identity takes 是, existence takes 有, location takes 在. Learn the split once, use it forever.

visible_text_sample.opening_paragraph: 第二个优势是送气。普通话的 b/p、d/t、g/k 之间的区别本来就是送气与不送气，而不是清浊。这意味着让英语母语者痛苦数月的 क 与 ख 的区别，对你来说几乎是免费的。
visible_text_sample.closing_paragraph: 脱离每周学习时长的「诚实数字」并不存在。读懂天城文大约需要三十到五十小时，因为字母表音且数量有限。问候、数字、价格、问路这类「生存印地语」大约一百小时。能就自己的生活进行简单交谈、错误不妨碍理解，大约在三百到五百小时之间。
